disabled.description: Do not serve the admin API.

jwt.description: Verify a JWT against a JWKS.

decision.description: Default decision model, such as typesafe/jev-1.13.0. Pin a version in production.

retry.description: Tries per model before the next model of the chain.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP endpoint; empty turns tracing off.

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics on the admin API.

to.description: Destinations that get the refused message, with the schema.error attribute set.

OPENAI_API_KEY is sent as a bearer token; a server other than the default may need none.

key.description: Template of the ordering key, such as {{ .json.customer_id }}. Empty: the source's natural order unit (kafka partition, mqtt topic, amqp queue, sqs message group, ...). A constant ("all") orders the whole source.

name.description: Plugin name, used in logs and metrics.

command.description: The plugin binary: a path, relative to the spec file, or a name looked up on PATH.

env.description: Environment variables set for the plugin (values may use {{secrets.X}}).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the binary. When set, hikyaku refuses to start a binary that does not match.

deadline.description: Overall budget across attempts and fallbacks (default none).

retry_budget.description: Caps retries as a fraction of traffic.

destinations.description: Not ready while a required destination can take nothing: every member of it, and of every fallback in its chain, is down (default true).

models.description: Not ready while every model of an AI route's chain fails. A probe calls each model once; /readyz answers from the last probe and refreshes one older than 30s in the background.

max_attempts.description: Give up after this many failed connects in a row; 0 = forever.

timeout.description: How long the caller waits (default 30s); then 504.

attempts.description: Tries per endpoint; 1 means no retry (default 5).

jitter.description: full (default): random in [0, wait]; equal: wait/2 + random half; none.

retry_on.description: Error tags retried (default connect, timeout, 5xx, 429): ranges (5xx), codes (503), classes (connect, timeout) and protocol codes (ws:close_1011).

never_on.description: Error tags never retried (default 4xx). A more specific retry_on tag wins, so 429 and 408 still retry.

respect_retry_after.description: Wait what Retry-After (or a broker hint) says, capped by max_backoff (default true).

ratio.description: Retries allowed per first attempt in the window (default 0.2).

store.description: Store that shares the counters across replicas (default: in-process).

filter.description: CEL expression over msg; false skips the route.

router.description: The router; default static over to:.

type.description: static, rules (CEL), ai, or sticky (last destinations of the history key).

when.description: CEL condition over msg: only the messages it is true for reach this router; the others skip it, with no call, and go to the next router of the fallback chain. On an ai router it keeps model spend to the messages that need a model, such as has(msg.json.text), msg.headers["X-Priority"] == "high" or msg.json.tier == "enterprise". A condition that cannot be evaluated (a missing field) counts as false.

match.description: rules: first matching rule (default) or every match.

default.description: rules: destinations when no rule matches (else the router fails over).

engine.description: ai: decision (System One, default) or generative (GenerateData on any model).

fallback_models.description: ai: overrides the global model fallback chain.

instructions.description: ai: the system message, in front of every question.

state.description: ai: per-message template of what the model evaluates (default {{ .bodyText }}).

state_json.description: ai: the state is JSON (sent as an object).

candidates.description: ai: the destinations the model may pick, each with what it is for.

multi.description: ai: true asks one yes/no per candidate (in one request) and delivers to every one above min_confidence; false asks one choice.

min_margin.description: ai, single choice: top minus second must exceed this.

input.description: ai: how the state is built.

timeout.description: ai: budget of the whole AI step, model fallbacks included (default 10s).

history.description: ai and sticky: route with past calls of a key.

on_low_confidence.description: ai: destinations when the model answered but was not sure.

fallback_on_low_confidence.description: ai: hand low-confidence answers to the router fallback instead of on_low_confidence.

shadow.description: ai: decide and log, but deliver through the fallback chain.

budget.description: ai: when exceeded, the route goes straight to the router fallback.

fallback.description: Routers tried in order when this one errors, times out, is over budget or (fallback_on_low_confidence) is unsure.

when.description: CEL expression over msg (msg.json, msg.headers, msg.subject, msg.source, ...).

on_invalid.description: On a route: where a body that does not match goes, instead of the dead-letter queue.

file.description: A JSON Schema file (JSON or YAML), read when the relay starts or reloads. A relative path is relative to the working directory.

shutdown_grace.description: Time in-flight messages get to finish on shutdown (default 20s).

type.description: Protocol: http, https, ws, wss, sse, stdin, file (M1); see the protocol matrix for the rest.

mode.description: listen (hikyaku is the server), poll (pull on a schedule) or subscribe (long-lived client). Defaults per protocol.

path.description: listen: request path (default /); file: the file to read.

methods.description: http listen: accepted methods (default POST, PUT).

tls.description: TLS (and mTLS with client_ca_file) for listen, DTLS for udp; client TLS for poll and subscribe.

ack.description: delivered (default) or accepted. http and grpc listen: delivered answers once the message is delivered or dead-lettered, accepted as soon as it is queued (on disk with a disk buffer). Subscribe sources: delivered acknowledges the broker once the outcome is final, accepted once the message is queued (safe with buffer.type: disk only).

respond.description: http and grpc listen: send a destination's reply back to the caller (smart reverse proxy; grpc maps it into the method's output type).

max_body_bytes.description: Largest accepted message (default 10MiB; grpc and openai 4MiB; tcp, udp and mqtt 1MiB). A listen source refuses a larger one (http 413, grpc RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED); a subscribe or poll source logs it and acknowledges it, so it cannot loop forever.

retry.description: poll (http, s3): retries per poll before skipping to the next interval. gcs retries its reads itself.

dedupe.description: Drop messages whose key was seen within the ttl, on any source (poll dedupe, cross-replica idempotency). A duplicate is acked as filtered and counted in hikyaku_deduped_total.

split.description: poll: jq expression that splits one response into several messages, such as .items[]. s3, gcs: also lines, one message per non-empty line of an object (NDJSON).

failover_urls.description: subscribe (ws, wss, sse, grpc, nats, jetstream, mqtt, amqp, redis): URLs rotated through when the primary is down.

format.description: stdin and file: each line is a message body (default) or an envelope in wire form.

follow.description: file: keep reading lines appended to the file.

topic.description: kafka, mqtt: the topic (mqtt: a topic filter); eventhubs: the event hub; servicebus: the topic (with subscription).

topics.description: kafka, mqtt: several topics (mqtt: filters) instead of topic.

group.description: kafka, redis streams, eventhubs: consumer group; mqtt v5: shared subscription group ($share/<group>/<filter>).

start.description: Where a new consumer starts. kafka, redis streams, eventhubs: earliest or latest (default latest); jetstream: all, new (default) or last.

username.description: mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: user name (mqtt, amqp and redis also take it in the URL; this field wins).

password.description: mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: password; use {{secrets.X}}.

creds_file.description: nats: a .creds file (JWT and NKey seed).

subject.description: nats: subject (wildcards * and > allowed); jetstream: filter subject of the consumer.

queue.description: nats: queue group (members share the messages); amqp: the queue consumed; servicebus: the queue.

prefetch.description: Messages a subscribe source keeps in flight: amqp prefetch, jetstream max_ack_pending, redis streams entries read and not acknowledged, kafka records buffered, mqtt v5 receive maximum, pubsub max outstanding, servicebus prefetch (default 64); nats: messages buffered before the client drops them (default 65536). sqs: messages per receive, 1 to 10 (default 10).

ack_wait.description: jetstream: redelivery delay of an unacknowledged message; redis streams: how long a pending entry stays idle before it is reclaimed and delivered again (default 30s for both).

stream.description: jetstream: the stream; redis: the stream key (XREADGROUP).

consumer.description: redis streams: this consumer's name in the group (default <host name>-<source name>); keep it stable, a restart resumes the entries it left pending.

durable.description: jetstream: durable consumer name, so a restart resumes where it stopped (default the source name).

channel.description: redis pub/sub: channel, or a pattern with * (PSUBSCRIBE).

client_id.description: mqtt: client identifier, which keys a persistent session; kafka: client.id. Default hikyaku-<relay>-<source>.

clean_session.description: mqtt: start a clean session (default false: the broker keeps the session and queued QoS 1/2 messages across reconnects).

exchange.description: amqp: exchange the queue is bound to (with routing_key).

routing_key.description: amqp: binding key of the queue on exchange.

declare.description: amqp: declare the queue (durable) and its binding when missing.

descriptor_set.description: grpc: a FileDescriptorSet file (protoc --descriptor_set_out --include_imports) describing the services.

services.description: grpc listen: the services of descriptor_set to serve (default all); hikyaku.relay.v1.Relay is always served.

reflection.description: grpc listen: serve the reflection service (default true); subscribe: resolve method through server reflection when there is no descriptor_set (default true).

frame.description: tcp, udp: framing. newline (default): one message per line; length: each message after a length_bytes big-endian length; raw: tcp, a connection's whole stream; udp, each datagram.

length_bytes.description: tcp, udp: size of the length prefix with frame: length (default 4).

queue_url.description: sqs: the queue URL. sns, eventbridge: the SQS queue subscribed to the topic or rule.

visibility_timeout.description: sqs: how long a received message stays hidden (default the queue's).

prefix.description: s3, gcs: only objects under this prefix.

after.description: s3, gcs: what happens to an object once its messages are final: keep (remembered in state_store), delete (default) or move (to move_to).

move_to.description: s3, gcs: prefix objects are moved under with after: move.

state_store.description: Store (by name) that keeps a source's progress: eventhubs checkpoints, s3/gcs objects already read with after: keep. Default the first store.

subscription.description: pubsub: the subscription; servicebus: the topic subscription.

aws.description: sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3: AWS region and credentials (default the SDK's chain).

gcp.description: pubsub, gcs: project and credentials (default Application Default Credentials).

azure.description: servicebus, eventhubs: connection string or namespace and credentials.

models.description: openai: the model names /v1/models lists and clients may ask for (default [hikyaku]); route on msg.json.model.

ordering.description: Deliver messages with the same key one at a time, in arrival order.

options.description: Settings of a plugin type (a source registered by a custom build); the plugin decodes and validates them.

mode.description: model (default): ask the model whether it is a follow-up; always_last: always reuse the last destinations, no model call.

type.description: redis, or memory (in-process: local runs and tests).

timeout.description: Per-operation timeout (default 50ms): reads must never stall routing.

circuit_breaker.description: Stops hammering a dead store (default on).

servers.description: Known servers: typesafe (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), openrouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), workersai (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN), ollama (no key).

custom.description: Any other server that speaks the System One protocol.

workersai_account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID for workersai (else CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID).

ollama_url.description: Base URL of the Ollama decision server (default http://localhost:11434).

provider.description: Plugin name and model prefix: models are <provider>/<id>.

enabled.description: Use TLS (implied by any other field and by https/wss).

cert_file.description: Certificate (server cert, or client cert for mTLS).

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the server.

client_ca_file.description: listen: CA bundle that verifies client certificates (mTLS).

TagList.description: Error tags: classes (connect, timeout), ranges (5xx, 4xx), exact codes (503, or a bare number) and protocol codes (ws:close_1011).

filter.description: CEL expression; false drops the message from this route or destination.

jq.description: jq program over the JSON body; its output is the new body.

template.description: Go template rendered as the new body.

headers.description: Set, add or remove headers (values are templates).

content_type.description: Set the content type (alone, or after jq or template).

redact.description: JSONPaths whose values are replaced with [redacted] in the JSON body, such as $.card.number or $..email.

validate.description: Check the JSON body against a JSON Schema; a body that does not match is a failure.

name.description: Relay name. Used in metrics, logs and the shared-state keys.

secrets.description: Secrets by name, each a mamori ref (env:NAME, file:///path, vault://..., or a comma-separated chain tried in order, such as env:A,file:///run/a). Reference one as {{secrets.NAME}}.

genkit.description: Genkit plugins for the AI router.

models.description: Default models, model retries and model fallback chains.

defaults.description: Delivery policy inherited by every destination (each field on its own).

stores.description: Shared-state backends (history, decision cache, dedupe, idempotency, budgets), referenced by name. The first one is the default store; with none, an in-process memory store is used.

dead_letter.description: Where a message goes when a required destination and all its fallbacks failed. Defaults to stderr.

routes.description: Which destinations get the messages of which sources.

observability.description: Logs, OpenTelemetry traces and Prometheus metrics.

buffer.description: The queue between sources and delivery workers.

egress.description: SSRF guard for destinations whose URL host is a per-message template.

plugins.description: Out-of-process plugins: binaries hikyaku starts and talks gRPC to. Each one adds the source and destination types it declares.

title: hikyaku.yaml
description: A hikyaku relay: sources, destinations, routes and their retry and fallback policies. See https://xavidop.github.io/hikyaku/docs/spec-reference/.
